summary: End-to-end testing of Meridian News publish flow. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (public articles list/filter/detail, admin list/stats/create, publish flow including 200/400/404 and media serving). Frontend: homepage renders hero + category cards with watermark-overlay badges, category filter navigates to /category/technology, article detail shows watermarked media, admin dashboard shows stats and per-row Publish/View Live actions. Publish button flips status Pending→Published and toast fires; New Article dialog creates a pending article that appears in the table.

issues: Success toast overlaps the 'New Article' button in the top-right corner on 1920px width, briefly obscuring the trigger. Consider adjusting toast position or z-order relative to the header actions.

action_items: Non-blocking: articles created without an image render an , producing a browser console warning ('empty string was passed to the src attribute'). Guard the render or use a placeholder when source_image_url/watermarked_image_url is empty.
Non-blocking: shadcn DialogContent is missing an aria-describedby/Description, causing an a11y console warning. Add <DialogDescription> to the create-article modal.
Optional: toast position may overlap the 'New Article' trigger button briefly after submit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores watermarked media synchronously inside a request handler via run_in_executor; publishing large images could exceed request timeout. Consider background task with status polling.

process_publish_media falls back to /api/wm?src=<external_url> on storage failure, which requires re-fetching + re-watermarking on every request (no cache). Acceptable as fallback but log a warning to alert-worthy severity.
No pagination on GET /api/articles and /api/admin/articles (hard limit 500). Fine for now; add paging before scale.
No auth on /api/admin/* endpoints (per spec 'no auth'), so anyone can publish. Document/ack risk.
server.py is 521 lines; consider splitting routes, watermarking, and storage modules.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 2 TEST_ articles (backend + UI). Additionally one previously-pending seed article was published as part of end-to-end verification. Data still resides in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints & publish flow verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be re-run for regression. Focus any future runs on the two minor UX/console warnings listed under action_items. Note: seed count in Mongo has grown due to TEST_ articles; assertions in tests use >= where relevant.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor console warnings are cosmetic (empty img src for image-less articles, missing DialogDescription for a11y) and can be fixed by conditional rendering of and adding a element.
